title: tekel pulchella
intro: Tekel pulchella, commonly known as the "Queen's Gowan" or "Pulchella", is a flowering plant in the family Boraginaceae. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, which include reducing inflammation, improving respiratory health, and possessing antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Tekel pulchella include its ability to act as an anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and expectorant, making it useful in treating various conditions such as bronchitis and coughs. The bioactive constituents of Tekel pulchella include alkaloids and flavonoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
